Free lead magnet

How bad is your secrets sprawl? Score yourself in ten minutes.

A ten-question self-assessment that tells you how exposed your secrets and pipelines are, and what to fix first. Free, no call required. Answer honestly and you will know within ten minutes whether you need the full assessment.

The ten questions

  1. Can you list, right now, every place a production database password lives?
  2. Are any credentials hard-coded in application source or CI configuration?
  3. Do any secrets sit in plaintext in environment files or CI variables?
  4. Are secrets rotated automatically, or only when someone remembers?
  5. Do you know which secrets have leaked into git history?
  6. Do machine and workload identities use short-lived credentials?
  7. Is there a single audited broker issuing secrets, or many stores?
  8. Can you revoke a compromised credential everywhere within minutes?
  9. Do developers need to see raw secrets to do their jobs?
  10. Could you evidence all of the above to an enterprise auditor this week?

Score one point for every clean answer. Under seven and secrets sprawl is already a live risk to your next enterprise deal or audit.
